update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.77 - Retry Guard, Auto-Start Fix, and UI Optimisations
Added ----- - RetryGuard class unifying retry counters across auto-select, confirm-dialog, and career-start flows.
Fixed ----- - auto_select and confirm_auto_select dialogs shared a single counter; the second dialog type was prematurely dismissed once the first hit the cap. They now use independent guards. - Retry counters were not reset after a cap-exceeded forced close, so the next fresh dialog was closed immediately. Each guard now resets after a forced close. - enableAutoStartCareer no longer requires enableParentFarmingMode; career auto-start works for any single run with the toggle on. - Log viewer run-completion notification fired multiple times on WebSocket reconnect; deduplicated by timestamp. - ErrorReportContext seenLogIds set grew unbounded; replaced with a single high-water-mark ref.
Changed ------- - APTITUDE_DIMENSION_ROWS extracted from AptitudeHeatmap and RunComparisonView into aptitudeGrade.ts. - RunComparisonView quality scores and best-stat map now precomputed with useMemo instead of recalculated per render.
